sec: Cushing's syndrome: definitions, causes table and metabolic effects · p844

items.exp: Cushing's syndrome = hypercortisolism (↑↑cortisol), secreted by the zona fasciculata (75% of adrenal cortex). (Book p844)

items.q: Match cause category — 1) Cushing exogenous (m/c)  2) Cushing inherited defect  3) Pseudocushing … A) Chronic stress of obesity, alcohol, depression  B) Exogenous steroid  C) AME
items.exp: Cushing: exogenous steroid (m/c), inherited defect AME, acquired ↑cortisol; pseudocushing = chronic stress from obesity, alcohol, depression. (Book p844)

items.q: In the causes table, cortisol (G.C. + M.C.) is inactivated to cortisone (G.C.) by:
items.exp: Cortisol → cortisone via 11β (OH) steroid dehydrogenase type-2. (Book p844)

opts: ↑ protein catabolism with ↓ AA uptake in muscle → proximal muscle myopathy
items.exp: ↑ protein catabolism, ↓ AA uptake in extrahepatic tissue (muscles), ↓ muscle protein synthesis → proximal muscle myopathy. (Book p844)

items.q: The carbohydrate effect of cortisol is a.k.a. ___.
items.exp: The carbohydrate arm is a.k.a. adrenal diabetes mellitus: ↑ hepatic AA (alanine) uptake, ↑ gluconeogenesis (alanine >> FFA), ↑ FFA. (Book p844)

items.q: For gluconeogenesis, the preferred substrate order stated is:
The fat effect of cortisol is best described as:
opts: Centripetal obesity with buffalo hump; lipolysis ↑ (minimal)
Uniform whole-body fat gain and lipolysis
Fat loss over the trunk with limb obesity
items.exp: Fat redistributes centripetally (buffalo hump) with minimal ↑ lipolysis. (Book p844)

items.q: The mineralocorticoid-action triad of cortisol excess is:
items.exp: Mineralocorticoid action triad: HTN, metabolic alkalosis, hypokalaemia. (Book p844)

items.q: The sex-steroid actions listed are acne, hirsutism and, reproductively:
items.exp: Sex steroid action: acne, hirsutism; reproductive amenorrhoea > oligomenorrhoea (m/c). (Book p844)

items.q: The CNS effect of steroid excess described is:
opts: Steroid-induced psychosis, from frank depression to hypomanic depression
items.exp: CNS effect: steroid-induced psychosis — depression (frank to hypomanic). (Book p844)
